_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Sluice/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, the controller [0,0,0]: the head cell, nearest the player; the sluice runs south from it, three blocks. Nothing moves: no power cell, no work, no driver. infeedCell/infeedFace: a vanilla chute from above meets the infeed section; waterCell/waterFace: a ppex pipe meets the water inlet; tailingsCell/tailingsFace: the tailings chute leaves the tail; concentrateCell/concentrateFace: the concentrate chute leaves the concentrate box, which the launder under the riffles fills through their draw slots as the sluice runs. feedSpout is where the ore falls into the head box, waterSpout the nozzle's mouth, concentrateSpout where the launder pours into the concentrate box. See the sluice's README for the schema.
